description:
An unresolvable parameter annotation reports its location as `<generated>` instead of the annotation's line and column. This is the same on the base and on 0da8a7a8d (scratch sc821/direct.fz):

    def ist(_v :: tuple), do: true
    def ist(_), do: false
    def main() do
      dbg(ist({1}))
    end

gives `error[resolve/type-alias]: compiler2 could not resolve parameter annotation 1 for `ist/1`: unknown type name `tuple`` at `--> <generated>`.

The same error now also comes from guard-helper reification (SourcePatternError::ParamAnnotation, emit_guard_dispatch_error), which shares the row builder surface_pattern_rows (src/compiler2/dispatch.rs).

To establish first: which span reaches the diagnostic. The annotation's own span is the target; find where it is lost (param_annotations in FunctionSurface, or resolve_type_expr_body's error span).

Fixture: a diagnostic fixture whose expected output names the annotation's line and column, for both a direct call and a guard helper.
title: An annotation error points at the annotation
